items.item:
4. In the first release publishing `estimate` is accepted and its pointer
   names PresuPro; publishing `Estimate`, which differs from it only in
   letter case, is refused as an unknown type. Shows A22-1.
   [witness: verification:registry_a22_first_release_declares_only_estimate]

verdicts.why: The check asserts that publishing `estimate` succeeds with owner service `presupro`, and that `Estimate` and two other spelling variants are refused as unknown types. It does not establish the exact closed set `{estimate -> PresuPro}` because it samples only three undeclared names rather than asserting that every other possible type is undeclared.
